instruction: Cinematic medium shot of a contemporary dance group in a dark indoor studio. On the left, the woman in the mustard yellow shirt (R2) with straight brown hair tilts her head back, looking upward. In the center background, the bearded man in the rust-colored shirt (R1) looks up. To the right, the clean-shaven man in the rust-colored shirt (R3) is in profile facing right, head bowed, while the woman in the mustard yellow shirt (R4) with curly strawberry-blonde hair stands on the far right looking forward. They are clustered together, all raising their arms high with curved hands toward the ceiling. Moody overhead lighting highlights the warm earth tones of their clothing against the dark charcoal background.
elements: R2 tilts her head back and looks upward while R3 has his head bowed in profile
R3 is in profile facing right with his head bowed while R1 looks upward
R4 looks forward while R2 looks upward with her head tilted back
R1, R2, R3, and R4 all raise their arms high with curved hands toward the ceiling
The group is in a dark indoor studio with moody overhead lighting
